label: Access this legacy item
summary: Gives access to the legacy item itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type; the same name appears on many other types.

label: Dynasty prestige increased
summary: Whether the dynasty's prestige went up, as a yes or no.
details: Going by its name, it is a yes/no check on a legacy item (an entry of the succession and legacy view in the game's windows). Which period it covers is not documented. The base game does not use it anywhere.

label: Attended activities
summary: The list of activities this ruler attended.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the succession event window, and shows that list only when it has entries.

label: Attended activities text
summary: A text listing the activities this ruler attended.
details: Vanilla puts it under the line "Attended N activities" in the legacy tooltip.

label: Hosted activities
summary: The list of activities this ruler hosted.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the succession event window, and shows that list only when it has entries.

label: Hosted activities text
summary: A text listing the activities this ruler hosted.
details: Vanilla puts it under the line "Hosted N activities" in the legacy tooltip.

label: Character
summary: The character this legacy item is about.
details: Vanilla chains further character functions onto it, for example the short name, the age and the culture's collective noun, to write the legacy texts.

label: Dread
summary: The ruler's dread as a number with decimals.
details: Vanilla compares it with the game's define for the intimidated dread level to decide whether a part of the succession event window is shown. Dread is how much others fear the ruler.

label: Dynasty prestige
summary: The dynasty's prestige as a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the function that turns it into a prestige level name, for the line "The dynasty became ...".

label: End date
summary: The date this ruler's time ended.
details: Vanilla takes its year or its full date text for the "Played: start to end" lines.

label: Finisher perks
summary: The perks the name calls finisher perks.
details: Going by its name, it returns those perks as a list or object. The base game does not use it; vanilla uses the text version, GetFinisherPerksList, which it shows under the lifestyle name.

label: Finisher perks text
summary: A text listing the ruler's finisher perks.
details: Vanilla shows it under the lifestyle name in the legacy tooltip, so it likely lists perks of that lifestyle; the exact selection is not documented.

label: Founded faith
summary: The faith this ruler founded.
details: Vanilla uses its name in the tooltip "Is the founder of ...", its icon as a picture, and its validity check to show the part only when the ruler founded a faith.

label: Founded house
summary: The dynasty house this ruler founded.
details: Vanilla uses its name in the tooltip "Is the founder of House ...", and shows the part only when the house is valid, meaning the ruler founded one.

label: Lifestyle
summary: The lifestyle this ruler is known for.
details: Vanilla uses its name in the tooltip, its icon as a picture, and shows the part only when the lifestyle is valid.

label: Number of attended activities
summary: How many activities this ruler attended.
details: Vanilla writes it into the line "Attended N activities".

label: Number of hosted activities
summary: How many activities this ruler hosted.
details: Vanilla writes it into the line "Hosted N activities".

label: Defensive holy wars
summary: How many defensive holy wars the ruler fought.
details: Going by its name, it counts defensive wars of the holy war kind (GH is probably short for great holy war). The base game does not use it.

label: Defensive wars
summary: How many defensive wars the ruler fought.
details: Going by its name, it counts the wars in which the ruler was attacked. The base game does not use it.

label: Offensive holy wars
summary: How many offensive holy wars the ruler fought.
details: Going by its name, it counts offensive wars of the holy war kind (GH is probably short for great holy war). The base game does not use it.

label: Offensive wars
summary: How many offensive wars the ruler fought.
details: Going by its name, it counts the wars the ruler started. The base game does not use it.

label: Piety level
summary: The ruler's piety level as a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the functions that give the level's name and icon.

label: Prestige level
summary: The ruler's prestige level as a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the functions that give the level's name and icon.

label: Reign length
summary: A text giving how long this ruler played.
details: Vanilla shows it in brackets after the start and end years.

label: Score
summary: The legacy score of this ruler as a whole number.
details: Vanilla writes it into the line "Score: N".

label: Start date
summary: The date this ruler's time began.
details: Vanilla takes its year or its full date text for the "Played: start to end" lines. A separate text shows only the start year followed by a dash (LEGACY_REIGN_CURRENT); that this is for the current ruler is read from its key name.

label: Number of wars
summary: How many wars the ruler fought in.
details: Vanilla writes it into the line "Has fought in N wars", followed by the war breakdown text.

label: Tyranny
summary: The ruler's tyranny as a number with decimals.
details: Going by its name and type, it is the ruler's tyranny value. The base game does not use it.

label: War breakdown
summary: A text breaking down the wars the ruler fought.
details: Vanilla shows it under the line "Has fought in N wars".

label: Has fought in war
summary: Whether the ruler fought in at least one war.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a part of the succession event window.

label: Is current
summary: Whether this legacy item is the current ruler's.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name belong to a debug tutorial list item.

label: This legacy item
summary: The legacy item itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the item on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type; the same name is common on other types.

label: Was cultural head
summary: Whether the ruler was the head of their culture.
details: Vanilla uses it together with whether the character is alive, to show one of two variants of the cultural head marker.

label: Access this viewer
summary: Gives access to the legal documents viewer itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Agree
summary: Accepts the legal document being shown.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in the legal documents viewer (a Paradox account screen). Going by its name, it records that the player agreed; what happens next is not documented.

label: Document text
summary: The text of the legal document being shown.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of a text box in the legal documents screen.

label: Hide viewer
summary: Hides the legal documents viewer.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name belong to other things.

label: This viewer
summary: The legal documents viewer itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the viewer on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Show viewer
summary: Shows the legal documents viewer.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name belong to other things.

label: Access this legend
summary: Gives access to the legend itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Complete legend
summary: A command that completes the legend.
details: It returns a command, not a value. Vanilla wraps it in the usual command helpers: one opens a popup for it, one checks whether the command is allowed (it enables the button), and one reads its description for the tooltip. A separate game text says completing a legend makes it impossible to start it again.

label: Custom text
summary: A custom text of the legend, picked by name.
details: It works like the Custom text functions of other types: it takes the name of a custom localization and returns its text. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name belong to other types.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom localization.

label: Chapter text by number
summary: The text of one chapter of the legend, picked by its position.
details: Vanilla asks for position 0 (written as '(int32)0') in a tooltip. That counting starts at 0 is an inference from that single use.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The position of the chapter.

label: Chapter text by name
summary: The text of one chapter of the legend, picked by its name.
details: Vanilla asks for the chapter named 'opening' of a finished legend, in the text of the decision to write a legend book.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the chapter.
fields.values: a name in quotes, such as 'opening'

label: All chapter texts
summary: The chapter descriptions of the legend as one text.
details: Going by its name and its text return type. The base game does not use it; how the chapters are combined is not documented.

label: Completion date
summary: The date the legend was completed.
details: Vanilla takes its year for the line "start year - completion year" of a completed legend.

label: Creation date
summary: The date the legend was created.
details: Vanilla takes its year for the legend's time span: "year - ..." while it is active, "year - year" once completed.

label: Provinces reached
summary: In how many provinces the legend has spread so far.
details: Vanilla shows it as "Spread in baronies" and compares it with 0 to decide whether to show a part of the legends window. A province here is a barony.

label: Description
summary: The description text of the legend.
details: Vanilla adds it under the legend's name in the tooltip of the legend header.

label: Impact modifiers text
summary: A text listing the modifiers the legend gives to one group of targets.
details: Vanilla asks for 'province', 'county' and 'owner', and shows each list under its own heading in the legend's tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which group of targets to list.

label: Last owner
summary: The last character who owned the legend.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it.

label: Maintenance cost
summary: The upkeep cost of the legend for a given character.
details: Vanilla passes the character and shows the result as a monthly cost.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the cost is worked out for.

label: Provinces needed for upgrade
summary: How many provinces the legend must spread to before its quality can be upgraded.
details: Vanilla shows it in the hint "Upgrade quality at N" and in the warning that the legend must spread to N baronies.

label: Name
summary: The name of the legend.
details: Vanilla uses it in messages and tooltips, for example when a promoted legend is completed or added to the library. The name carries a tooltip when shown; GetNameNoTooltip is the version without it.

label: Name without tooltip
summary: The name of the legend, without a tooltip on it.
details: Vanilla uses it in titles, such as "Complete ..." and "Promote ...", and inside tooltips.

label: Completion effects text
summary: A text describing what happens when the legend is completed.
details: Vanilla adds it to the warning that completing a legend makes it impossible to start it again.

label: Owner
summary: The character who owns the legend.
details: Vanilla uses the owner's name in the legend's texts and tooltips.

label: Portrait animation
summary: The name of the animation for the legend's portrait.
details: Vanilla passes it as the animation of an animated character portrait in the legend chronicle window.

label: Promoters
summary: The list of characters who promote the legend.
details: Vanilla counts them for the promoters line and uses the list as the data source in the legends window. It also shows a part of the window when the list is empty.

label: Property
summary: A named property of the legend.
details: Going by its name, it takes the name of a property. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name belong to other things.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the property.

label: Protagonist
summary: The character the legend is about.
details: Vanilla uses it in the legend book decision text and in the legend's subtitle ("type about protagonist").

label: Quality level
summary: The legend's quality level as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the legends window and in a tooltip. Vanilla's quality names include famed, illustrious and mythical.

label: Legend type
summary: The type of the legend.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of the HUD and the chronicle window, and takes its name for the subtitle "type about protagonist".

label: Upgrade cost
summary: What it costs a given character to upgrade the legend's quality.
details: Vanilla passes the character and shows the result as a cost string.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would pay.

label: Has impact modifiers
summary: Whether the legend gives modifiers to one group of targets.
details: Vanilla asks for 'province', 'county' and 'owner' and shows the matching list only when the answer is yes.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which group of targets to check.

label: Has quality
summary: Whether the legend has the given quality level.
details: Vanilla checks 'mythical' and 'illustrious' to show or hide parts of the legends window and the upgrade hint.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The quality to check.
fields.values: a quality name in quotes, such as 'mythical'

label: Increase quality
summary: A command that raises the legend's quality by one level.
details: It returns a command, not a value. Vanilla posts it from a button, checks whether it is allowed to enable the button, and reads its description for the tooltip. That it goes up by exactly one level is read from its name.

label: Is promoting legend
summary: Whether the given character is promoting this legend.
details: Vanilla passes the player and uses the answer, or its opposite, to show parts of the legend windows.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character to check.

label: Is completed
summary: Whether the legend is completed.
details: Vanilla uses it to show different parts of the HUD and the chronicle window for finished and unfinished legends.

label: Is promoted in province
summary: Whether the legend is being promoted in the given province right now.
details: Vanilla combines it with WasPromotedOnCompletionInProvince in the county view to show or hide a legend part.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The province to check.

label: Is hovered
summary: Whether the mouse is over the legend.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; other types have a function of the same name that vanilla uses to highlight a hovered row.

label: Is in library
summary: Whether the legend is in the given character's legend library.
details: Vanilla passes the player and shows different parts of the chronicle window depending on the answer.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose library is checked.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the legend is selected.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; other types have a function of the same name that vanilla uses to show a pressed row.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether the legend exists.
details: Vanilla checks it before showing parts of the HUD and the legends window, so those parts stay hidden when it is no.

label: Legend as scope
summary: Turns the legend into a script scope.
details: Vanilla passes the result to GetIllustration(...).GetTexture to pick the chronicle frame, illustration and divider pictures. The game's documentation names its type as Promote, and the return type is Scope.

label: On mouse enter
summary: Tells the legend that the mouse moved onto it.
details: Vanilla calls it in the mouse-enter state of a map icon template for legends (Legend_Mouse_Entry). Going by its name, the legend then counts as hovered.

label: On mouse leave
summary: Tells the legend that the mouse moved off it.
details: Vanilla calls it in the mouse-leave state of the same map icon template for legends. Going by its name, the legend then no longer counts as hovered.

label: Pan camera to legend
summary: Moves the map camera to the legend.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in the legends window. The game's tooltip text says the right-click pans to the legend on the map.

label: This legend
summary: The legend itself.
details: Vanilla passes it on as an argument, for example to start promoting the legend, to take an unowned legend, or to compare two legends.

label: Was promoted when completed
summary: Whether the legend was promoted in the given province when it was completed.
details: Vanilla combines it with IsCurrentlyPromotedInProvince in the county view to show or hide a legend part.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The province to check.

label: Zoom camera to legend
summary: Zooms the map camera to the legend.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; the lines with the same name are the character's version in the HUD.

label: Access this window
summary: Gives access to the legend chronicle window itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the legend chronicle window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close buttons.

label: Chapters
summary: The list of chapters of the legend shown in the chronicle window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of the chapter list in the window.

label: Legend
summary: The legend the chronicle window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context for the whole window, so everything inside refers to this legend.

label: This window
summary: The legend chronicle window itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the window on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Potential protagonists
summary: The list of characters who could be the protagonist of the new legend.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the character list in the legend creation window.

label: Access this window
summary: Gives access to the legend creation window itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Can create
summary: Whether the legend can be created with the current choices.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable the create button. When it is off, the button shows the reason from GetCanCreateDesc.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the legend creation window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close buttons.

label: Create legend
summary: Creates the legend from the current choices.
details: Vanilla calls it from the create button of the window. That button is only enabled when CanCreate is true.

label: Why not creatable
summary: A text telling whether and why the legend can or cannot be created.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of the create button while that button is disabled.

label: Completion text
summary: A text describing what completing a legend of the given quality gives.
details: Vanilla passes it a quality name chosen with nested selections: 'mythical' if a variable of that name exists, else 'illustrious' if that exists, else 'famed'. It uses the result as a text in the window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The quality to describe.
fields.values: a quality name: 'mythical', 'illustrious' or 'famed' (the ones vanilla uses)

label: Chosen protagonist
summary: The character picked as the legend's protagonist in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it for the window title "Create ..." and to mark the selected row in the character list.

label: Seed
summary: The legend seed the window is creating a legend from.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the window. A seed is the template a legend starts from.

label: This window
summary: The legend creation window itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the window on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Choose protagonist
summary: Sets the character who will be the protagonist of the new legend.
details: Going by its name and its one argument. The base game does not use it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character to choose.

label: Access this item
summary: Gives access to the legend list item itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Legend
summary: The legend this list item stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it when a row of the legends window is clicked: to open the legend's chronicle, or to set it as the focused legend (left or right click).

label: Modifiers
summary: The list of modifiers shown for this legend item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the legends window.

label: This item
summary: The legend list item itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the item on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Access this seed
summary: Gives access to the legend seed itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Creation cost
summary: What it costs a given character to create a legend from this seed.
details: Vanilla passes the character and shows the result as a cost string in the creation tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would pay.

label: Description
summary: The description text of the seed, as seen by a given character.
details: Vanilla passes the character and adds the text to the tooltips of the seed.

fields.name: Arg0

label: Impact modifiers text
summary: A text listing the modifiers a legend of this seed would give to one group of targets.

fields.text: Which group of targets to list.
fields.values: 'owner', 'promoter', 'province' (and likely 'county', which the legend version uses)

label: Maintenance cost
summary: What it costs a given character per month to maintain a legend from this seed.
details: Vanilla passes the character and shows the result as a monthly cost.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would pay.

label: Name
summary: The name of the seed, as seen by a given character.
details: Vanilla passes the character and uses the name in tooltips and in the legends window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the name is written for.

label: Name with protagonist
summary: The seed's name, written for a character and a chosen protagonist.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the name is written for.

fields.name: Arg1

label: Quality level
summary: The seed's quality level as text.

label: Quality
summary: The quality of a legend seed (a story that can be grown into a legend), as text.

label: Legend type
summary: The type of legend this seed makes.

label: Has impact modifiers
summary: Whether a legend of this seed would give modifiers to one group of targets.

fields.text: Which group of targets to check.

summary: Whether the seed has the given quality level.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The quality to check.

label: Access this type

label: Custom text
summary: A custom text of the legend type, picked by name.
details: It works like the Custom text functions of other types: it takes the name of a custom localization and returns its text. The base game does not use it on this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom localization.

label: Highlight icon
summary: The highlighted version of the legend type's icon.
details: Vanilla uses it as the picture of an icon in the shared icons file.

label: Icon
summary: The legend type's icon.
details: Vanilla uses it as the picture of icons and buttons.

label: Name
summary: The name of the legend type.
details: Vanilla reaches it through other functions such as GetType.GetName to show the type in text. The name is common to many types.

label: Has highlight icon
summary: Whether the legend type has a highlight icon.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it.

label: Has icon
summary: Whether the legend type has an icon.
details: Going by its name. The base game does not use it on this type; other types have a function of the same name that vanilla uses to show an icon only when it exists.

label: Legend type as scope
summary: Turns the legend type into a script scope.
details: The game's documentation names its definition type as Promote and the return type as Scope. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: This type
summary: The legend type itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the type on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Access this window
summary: Gives access to the legends window itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the common way to reach the object the expression started from. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Clear focused legend
summary: Removes the focus from the legend in the legends window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in the window.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the legends window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close button.

label: Distant active legends
summary: The list of legends still being formed outside the player's realm.
details: Vanilla shows its size in the heading "Forming Legends" and uses it as the data source of a list. That it means legends outside the realm is read from the name "Distant" and the realm version beside it.

label: Distant completed legends
summary: The list of completed legends outside the player's realm.
details: Vanilla shows its size in the heading "Completed Legends" and uses it as the data source of a list.

label: Focused legend
summary: The legend currently in focus in the legends window.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context, reads its legend (GetLegend) and checks whether that legend is valid, to decide what the window shows.

label: Library legends
summary: The list of legends in the player's library.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list and shows another part of the window when it is empty.

label: Promoted legend
summary: The legend the player currently promotes.
details: Vanilla reads its legend (GetLegend) and compares it with the row's legend, to change texts and what is visible.

label: Realm active legends
summary: The list of legends still being formed in the player's realm.
details: Vanilla shows its size in the heading "Forming Legends" and uses it as the data source of a list.

label: Realm completed legends
summary: The list of completed legends in the player's realm.
details: Vanilla shows its size in the heading "Completed Legends" and uses it as the data source of a list. It shows or hides parts of the window depending on whether it is empty.

label: This window
summary: The legends window itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the window on, for example as an argument to another function. The base game does not use it on this type.

label: Set current tab
summary: Switches the legends window to the given tab.
details: Going by its name and its one argument. The base game does not use it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The tab to show.
fields.values: a tab, probably a name or number
